description: This source file defines the internal sealed class 'SerializationCallbacksFactory' within the 'Orleans.Serialization' namespace. It provides functionality to create and cache delegates for serialization callback methods (lying with attributes like OnDeserializing, OnDeserialized, etc.) for both reference and value types, using Reflection and DynamicMethod emitting. The class supports retrieving these callbacks and creating delegate instances for methods marked with serialization attributes.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacksFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates delegates for callback methods used during object serialization/deserialization, supporting caching for performance.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacks<TDelegate>
classes.description: A nested class representing serialization callback delegates for different serialization states (deserializing, deserialized, serializing, serialized).

methods.name: GetReferenceTypeCallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves serialization callbacks for reference types with caching.

methods.name: GetValueTypeCallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves serialization callbacks for value types, with type parameters for owner type and delegate type.

methods.name: CreateTypedCallbacks
methods.description: Creates a set of callback delegates for a given type by inspecting its methods and their attributes.

methods.name: GetSerializationMethod
methods.description: Generates a DynamicMethod that invokes the specified callback method, adjusting parameters based on whether the owner type is a value or reference type.
